```json
],
"topology": "3-stage current-starved ring (shared starved rails, degenerated V-to-I bias, PMOS/NMOS mirrors) + 2-inverter output buffer",
"rationale": "Rs-degenerated vctrl device sets Ib≈(Vc−Vgs)/Rs, which is less sensitive to corners. Ib is mirrored K× into shared PMOS and NMOS starving rails. Ring at ~120 uA (tt) with ~15 fF per node gives f≈I/(3·C·VDD)≈1.5 GHz, ~1.1 GHz at ss/1.62 V. R0 keeps a minimum Ib so low vctrl still oscillates. Budget: 2·Ib + ring + buffer ≈ 260 uA tt, about 700 uW at ff/-40/1.98 V. Buffer gives rail-to-rail vout."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Ib":     (30e-6, 10e-6, 80e-6),    # bias branch current at mid vctrl (tt)
    "K":      (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),          # ring starving current / Ib
    "Cs":     (8e-15, 1e-15, 40e-15),   # explicit cap per ring node
    "Lb":     (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),         # mirror / starving device L
    "gmid_b": (10.0, 6.0, 15.0),        # mirror gm/Id
    "R0":     (120e3, 30e3, 1e6),       # minimum-current resistor (low vctrl start-up)
    "Wn":     (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),         # ring inverter NMOS width
    "buf":    (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),          # final buffer scale
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vlo, vhi = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    VDD = 1.8
    Ib = p["Ib"]
    K = max(1, int(round(p["K"])))
    Ir = K * Ib
    Lb, gb = p["Lb"], p["gmid_b"]

    # --- V-to-I: vctrl NMOS with source degeneration Rs ---
    vs = 0.35
    for _ in range(4):
        mc = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, Ib, vds=0.25, vsb=vs)
        vs = max(0.12, vmid - mc.vgs)
    Rs = vs / Ib

    # --- mirrors ---
    mpd = lut.size("p", gb, Lb, Ib, vds=1.0)        # PMOS diode (pb)
    mps = lut.size("p", gb, Lb, Ir, vds=0.3)        # PMOS ring starving (K*Ib)
    mpm = lut.size("p", gb, Lb, Ib, vds=0.8)        # PMOS feeding NMOS diode
    mnd = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, Ib, vds=0.7)        # NMOS diode (nb)
    mns = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, Ir, vds=0.3)        # NMOS ring starving (K*Ib)

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    n.dev("MC", "pb", "vctrl", "xs", "vss", mc)
    n.R("RS", "xs", "vss", Rs)
    n.R("R0", "pb", "vss", p["R0"])                 # guarantees minimum bias current
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("MPM", "nb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpm)
    n.dev("MND", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mnd)
    n.dev("MPS", "vsp", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
    n.dev("MNS", "vsn", "nb", "vss", "vss", mns)

    # --- 3-stage ring on shared starved rails ---
    Wn = p["Wn"]; Wp = 2.0 * Wn; Lr = 0.15
    nodes = ["r0", "r1", "r2"]
    for i in range(3):
        a, b = nodes[i], nodes[(i + 1) % 3]
        n.M(f"MRP{i}", b, a, "vsp", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lr)
        n.M(f"MRN{i}", b, a, "vsn", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Lr)
        n.C(f"CR{i}", b, "vss", p["Cs"])

    # --- output buffer: small inverter then scaled inverter ---
    n.M("MB1P", "bo", "r0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0 * Wn, Lr)
    n.M("MB1N", "bo", "r0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Lr)
    s = p["buf"]
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "bo", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0 * Wn * s, Lr)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "bo", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn * s, Lr)

    # --- first-order predictions ---
    cpar = 2.0e-15 * (Wn + Wp) * 2.0                 # gate + junction parasitics per node
    Ctot = p["Cs"] + cpar
    f_mid = Ir / (3.0 * Ctot * VDD)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 20e-15)
    cbuf = cl + 2.0e-15 * 3.0 * Wn * (1 + s)
    i_tot = 2 * Ib + Ir + cbuf * VDD * f_mid + VDD / p["R0"] * 0.4
    power = VDD * i_tot
    return n, {"f_mid": f_mid, "swing": 1.7, "power": power}
```
